text_block_list.text:
After reflecting on the race, Curren
Chan decides
to give up on the Triple
Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Instead, she changes her goal to
becoming the
most beloved runner,
believing it will help her
traverse the
path to cuteness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First, we set the pinnacle of all
sprints—the
Sprinters Stakes—as her
next race. We also add
the Aoi Stakes as
a way for her to get
reacclimated to
sprints before that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But that's not all. Каррен Тян also
seems to be
cooking up some other plan
outside of her races
and training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
